45786a73-258e-4f47-9437-31e84d0e00ca.envelopeLetterSub:
I made a little something
just for you...
certificateTerms: Forehead Kisses Policy. Guaranteed warm kisses whenever you're stressed or quiet.
Safe Haven Clause. You can be fully vulnerable, silly, or tired. I've got your back.
Snack Sharing Pact. What's mine is yours (especially the crispy fries).
Always My Priority. Even on busy days, you're the first and last thought in my mind.
Terms: valid for a lifetime, non-negotiable and unconditionally loved.
memoryNotes: the day you became my favourite notification ✿
this smile is still my biggest weakness.
we were laughing until our stomachs hurt.
you make ordinary days feel magical.
i'd choose you again in every single lifetime.
to be continued... together forever ✿
scratchCoupons: 🎟️ 1x Midnight Drive to Get Ice Cream Together
🎟️ 1x Free Pass to Pick Any Movie (I won't fall asleep!)
45786a73-258e-4f47-9437-31e84d0e00ca.voiceNoteTitle: A special voice note for you
45786a73-258e-4f47-9437-31e84d0e00ca.message: Every single day with you feels like home. Out of all 8 billion people on this planet, my heart found you, and I wouldn't change a single moment. I built this tiny corner of the internet just to remind you how deeply and truly you are loved.
